page.content:
Kirk's TOS command circle.

How Enterprise crew connects

  • Character: James T. Kirk — Kirk captains the TOS Enterprise crew.
  • Character: Spock — Spock is first officer of the TOS Enterprise crew.
  • Faction: Starfleet — The TOS Enterprise crew serves Starfleet.
  • Character: Nyota Uhura — Uhura is communications officer of the TOS crew.
  • Character: Leonard McCoy — McCoy is chief medical officer of the TOS crew.
  • Ship: USS Enterprise — Kirk's crew lives aboard the Enterprise.
  • Character: Montgomery Scott — Scott is chief engineer of the TOS crew.

What is Enterprise crew?

The Enterprise crew is the original command family: Kirk, Spock, McCoy, Uhura, Scott, Sulu, and Chekov on the Constitution-class ship.

Key threads lead to James T. Kirk, Spock, Starfleet, Nyota Uhura, Leonard McCoy and USS Enterprise.
